documents.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2026 - G.S.R. 128(E), 13 February 2026, in force 1 July 2026
documents.publisher: Fox Mandal (copy of the Gazette of India)
documents.notes: Inserts Rule 6(10A): e-commerce entities must offer a searchable, sortable country-of-origin filter for imported packaged goods.

documents.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2025 - G.S.R. 778(E), in force 24 October 2025
documents.notes: Medical devices: Medical Devices Rules 2017 prevail for font size and dimensions; Rule 33 exemptions do not apply where MDR 2017 applies.

documents.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second Amendment Rules, 2025 - G.S.R. 881(E), 2 December 2025, in force 1 February 2026
documents.notes: Adds a proviso to Rule 26(a) excluding pan masala from the small-package exemption.

documents.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second Amendment Rules, 2026 - 27 April 2026, in force 1 July 2027
documents.notes: Country-of-origin related; NOT yet in force on 21 Nov 2026.

documents.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Third Amendment Rules, 2026 - G.S.R. 418(E), 29 May 2026, in force 1 June 2026
documents.notes: Rule 4: importers may affix declarations in AEO Tier-2/3 bonded warehouses. Rule 27: named responsible Director, annual online update, registration valid until cancelled.
